newsitem.title: CHINA: Xinjiang Tunhe buys ICBC trust & investment shares.
newsitem.headline: Xinjiang Tunhe buys ICBC trust & investment shares.

text.p: Shanghai-listed A share firm, Xinjiang Tunhe Co Ltd, will buy 30 million shares in a trust and investment company held by the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, a company statement said on Friday.
The company will spend 64.5 million yuan to buy the stock, which accounts for 30 percent of the outstanding shares in Xinjiang Jinxin Trust and Investment Co Ltd, the statement said.
The purchase has been approved by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, but still requires the approval of a shareholders' meeting, the statement said.

The central bank launched a campaign two years ago to force state banks to close or sell all subsidiaries involved in stock trading or in the trust and investment business. Bankers say the process is almost complete.
